name: read-row-and-edit
finalText:
I found the Iuvaret4 row, read its Diceret cell, and clicked the edit link in that row.

- **Diceret cell value:** Phaedrum4. The page text showed the same value before and after the click.
- **Final URL:** https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/challenging_dom#edit
- **Ends with #edit:** Yes.

The page text after the click was identical to the text before it. The edit link only added `#edit` to the URL, and the page didn't otherwise change.

The `find` action isn't permitted in this session, so I located the row from the page text and the accessibility tree instead.
